knokkeroo — wearable screens, redesigned

Opening a face auto-registers a knok once (silent either way, matching the app's real passive-knok path, which has never shown UI feedback for success or failure). Tapping the kangaroo yourself is different: online it plays the real double-knock sound; offline it plays a distinct error sound/haptic instead.

Kangaroo artwork is assets/roo-transparent.png, trimmed to its real visible bounding box and sized to a verified-safe 62% of the screen. Success sound/haptic reproduces App.tsx's actual handleKnok/playDoubleKnock. The error tone is synthesized (no error sound asset exists in the repo yet) and only ever triggers on a manual tap while offline, never the silent auto-open knok. None of this is wired into the real wearable apps yet — still a browser preview for review.
